decision.reason: The evidence excerpts [ev-2875a348b5d7] and [ev-59d22c21eec4] only contain "/*". The change text shows a single added line in v2.0.0 core.go that returns an error saying external secret store support was removed and the --enable-external-secret-stores flag "will be removed in a future release". It does not show the condition that triggers the error, such as the flag being set or set to true. Without that code, I can't tell whether the right change type is behavior-changed, validation-tightened (a value that used to be accepted is now rejected) or removed (no longer honoured), or whether the "core" component belongs in the subject's identity. The surrounding code in cmd/crossplane/core/core.go, the if-block around this return in v2.0.0, is needed to decide.
